title: Do you hear the people sing, singing a song of angry men #theatre
transcript: I know right now that if you are anything like me, you're feeling incredibly helpless with everything that is happening in this country right now. And I do think it's incredibly important to remember that while it feels like the power is not in our hands, we are not completely powerless. There are small actions that we each can do from calling your senators, which does make a difference. I also think it's really important in times like this to gather. Gather in places where you can remind the people in charge that there are more of us than there are of them. If there is a protest anywhere near you, I highly recommend attending. And if you are in New York tomorrow on January 31st, go to the Public Theatre. They are doing an eight hour long People's Filibuster protest for humanity on the steps of the public. It is completely free. It is happening for eight hours. You do not have to be there the entire time. You can come and go as you please. Artists and speakers and politicians will be taking to the steps all day to speak out text and sing songs and remind people that what is happening in this country right now is not okay. If you are able to attend, I highly recommend bundling up in all your layers and showing up to the steps. Show the people that there are more of us. And if you cannot attend, they are going to be Doing a live stream of the entire event so you can still tune in. Remember that we are not alone.
